area: Jackstraw (the Thresher's Charge game) and the Amoebius race judge
summary: JackstrawController gained an AI seam (ArmAI, DisarmAI, TickAI, AIArmed, Settings, Heap; behaviour unchanged) and JackstrawHunter.ChooseRival is now a shared static, so Riposte flies its own Swordfish pilots on the same heap; SpawnableJackstraw publishes HeapRadius. In Port: RaceJudge accepts mode Jackstraw and Riposte as combat-point games, and the engine's FixedString128Bytes gained CopyFromTruncated, whose absence broke the Amoebius build on Ys-bleeding-edge (the petal ledger calls it).
why: Riposte's AI seats flew a slow knot at 30 u/s under Jackstraw's hunter; measuring and fixing it needed the judge to run the mode
